claims.quote: Probably restricted to southern parts of Karnataka state and northern Kerala state in southwestern India.

regions.name: Payaswini
regions.quote: Following its revalidation in 2015 (see 'Notes') it is known with certainty only from the Payaswini and Vallapattanam river systems in Kerala although it is thought to occur elsewhere.
